hooks: Did you know Street Fighter is the third live action film based on Capcom's game?
Kitao Sakurai directs the new 2026 Street Fighter action comedy movie.
Noah Centineo and Andrew Koji star as Ken and Ryu in Street Fighter.

evidence.1: The movie serves as a standalone reboot and fresh adaptation of Capcom's fighting game franchise, though it is the third live-action adaptation overall.
